speaker: william_shakespeare
text: After the king. Forty-odd leaves, clean. The whole comedy. It is yours, Abel, and it was not yours this morning.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: I will read it standing. I do not sit down to a fault. Give it here before the yard is empty and I lose the light in this parlour.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Here. A lady is Katharine, and on the next leaf she is Rosaline, and the lover does not change his name. Shall he woo them both, or will you choose?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I choose. They are two. Rosaline keeps Berowne. Katharine keeps Dumaine. Mend the leaves to that, and do not mend them to a third woman to save the copying.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Two. I can copy two. I cannot copy a lover who forgets which name he swore by. Forty-odd. I am not counting the odd until the ink is dry on the choice.

speaker: john_heminges
text: How long does it play?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Long.

speaker: john_heminges
text: How long?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am in pain, John.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Where?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: In the fifth act.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Then the account book can have one line, and the line can be dull. Navarre ended this day. I am not writing a length under it, and I am not writing a share.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: I have not had a roll. I am asking from the door. You tried it pleading, and you tried it plain. Is wanting a reward the point of a comedy?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I kept the plain refusal. It is the livelier. It is no safer at the box. The point is not a reward, and I am not giving you Armado's part across this table.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: I can speak it. I ask whether anyone will be listening. You kept the plain refusal. Is wanting a reward the point of a comedy? I can play a refusal. I cannot play a part I have not been given.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: No parts today. The book is in my hands. The rolls come when I have copied them, and I have not copied them. They do not go out from this table.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Friday, the license, if he will see it. Seven shillings when he has signed. Company coin. Not from your coffer, Will, and not from Edith's eight shillings. Those eight are still owing till Lady Day.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Seven shillings of the company's, on Friday, if he signs. I am not carrying a part out of this parlour. The letter at home is still unanswered. A clean book does not pay a seam, and it does not pay a carrier.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Then we are done with it for today. I will not tell Kemp there is a roll. There is not a roll.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Correct. There is a book, and there is a fault I have already marked, and there is a man who chose. That is enough for one afternoon.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Tasso was the Rose. None of us went. I am not putting their afternoon on our leaf under Navarre. One line is the discipline. A second line would be gossip.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: One line. I will not stand over your shoulder and improve it. Dull was the point of it.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: I can speak it, when there is an it. Until the rolls are copied, I am a man with a question and no roll. I can live in that condition. I have practiced.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Then live in it. I promised the book was in my hands. It is. I did not promise a roll by any morning you can name. Go and be paid nothing extra for standing here. None of you is owed a penny for this quarter-hour.

speaker: john_heminges
text: A penny is the right size of extra. There is no extra. The leaf has its one line. Shut the parlour.
